title: spartocytisus supranubius
intro: Spartocytisus supranubius, commonly known as the Spiny Broom, is a shrub native to the Mediterranean region. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues, making it a potential natural remedy for conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Spartocytisus supranubius include anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which can help alleviate congestion and coughs. Its bioactive constituents include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects, although further research is needed to fully understand its properties and potential applications.
